summary: FintechReimburse Group updated its Travel and Expense policies, effective September 1, 2023, around a new expense reporting platform. The platform automates receipt capture with OCR, checks policy compliance in real time, routes reports for manager approval, and promises reimbursement within 10 days of approval. It also offers analytics, strong data security, and training and support for staff.
one_line: FintechReimburse Group's T&E policy, effective September 1, 2023, introduces an automated expense platform with OCR, compliance checks, approvals, fast reimbursement, analytics and security.
key_facts: FintechReimburse Group's updated Travel and Expense policies take effect September 1, 2023.
Maya Patel, a lead software engineer, and her team designed the system that automates data input through digital receipt capture.
Employees snap a picture of a receipt and the system extracts the information using Optical Character Recognition technology.
Each expense must be classified using pre-set categories that correspond to the company's account codes, helping with budgeting and forecasting.

Data analyst Jonathan Smith developed the instant verification feature, which compares expenses to company policy rules in real time and notifies employees of possible non-compliance before submission.
Expense reports are routed automatically to the responsible manager, who is notified on submission; Finance Manager Michael Johnson says this increases accountability and speeds up approval.
High-value or exceptional expenditures may require additional authorization layers, such as higher management or specialized approvals.
Reimbursements are typically processed within 10 days or less after an expense report is approved.
Emily Chen, HR Director, embraced the system for its user-friendly approach; employees can track reimbursement status and progress.
CFO Alex Romano calls the intelligent analytics a game changer; reports can be generated by department, project or time period, with dashboards for executives.
Security measures include end-to-end encryption and regular audits, and Sofia Alvarez, IT Security Director, ensures adherence to the EU's GDPR and the US's CCPA.
Alerts notify the compliance team if suspicious activity is detected.
Training Coordinator Liam Wong leads training programs with multilingual support materials, plus a dedicated helpline and an FAQ database.
